OnInit:
	debugmes "[P34] ---- verifier start ----";

	// ---- no-RID: the *lang API must be callable with no attached player ----
	// A needtr() here would always have returned Korean. These carry BOTH strings
	// and let each recipient pick, which is what request section 19 asks for.
	mapannouncelang "sec_pri", "[P34] no-RID KR", "[P34] no-RID EN", bc_map;
	debugmes "[P34][NORID] mapannouncelang returned from OnInit with no attached RID";

	debugmes "[P34] ---- verifier done ----";
	bindatcmd "p34", "NEED Phase34 Verify::OnAtP34", 99, 99;
	end;
